raw_segments.text: Mr. Chairman, ladies and gentlemen, great was my admiration in listening to the remarks
addressed to the youth of Ireland a moment since by my learned friend.
It seemed to me that I had been transported into a country far away from this country,
into an age remote from this age, that I stood in ancient Egypt, and that I was listening
to the speech of some hyperiest of that land addressed to the youthful Moses.
